decision: 10 Second Stop and Go penalty imposed after the race in accordance with Article 38.3 (30 seconds added to elapsed race time). (2 penalty points awarded, 4 points total for the 12 month period)
event_name: Red Bull Toro Rosso Honda Document 34 Date 08 April 2018 Time 22:17 2018 BAHRAIN GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 April 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 29) and heard the driver and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 28 failed to re-establish the original start order by the first safety car line.
offence: Breach of Article 36.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: 10 Second Stop and Go penalty imposed after the race in accordance with Article 38.3 (30 seconds added to elapsed race time). (2 penalty points awarded, 4 points total for the 12 month period)
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence and heard from Brendon Hartley, the driver of car 28 and the team representative. Car 28 was overtaken by car 11 during the formation lap, failed to re-establish his position before the first safety car line and then did not enter the pits as required under Article 38.3. Gerd Ennser Paolo Longoni Danny Sullivan Mazen Al Hilli
rules_referenced: Article 36.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
